title: Catalog reconciliation, entitlement mapping, and automated billing comms for pricing refresh
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Objective: Ensure the new SKU and limits catalog is fully reconciled to billing metering, entitlement checks, and public-facing docs, plus automated release-note and billing-comm pipelines to minimize manual cutover work.

Scope: reconciliation of product catalog (SKUs, unit definitions, caps), mapping to entitlement IDs used by RBAC and billing, updates to public pricing docs and Console UI labels, automated generation of release notes and billing comms, sales enablement deck updates, and a small migration helper for affected customers.

Out of scope: full billing system re-architecture, backbilling decisions for legacy customers (handled by Finance escalation), international tax messaging (handled by Legal/Finance separately).
acceptance_criteria: All SKUs in pricing catalog have a canonical ID and a single source-of-truth entry in the pricing table
Entitlement mapping matrix exists linking SKU -> entitlement_id -> quota enforcement rule
Billing metering events (usage units) validated against new SKU definitions for 95% of sample traffic
Release notes and billing comms templates generated automatically from catalog diff and staged for review
Sales enablement deck updated and reviewed by GTM with recorded walkthrough
Migration helper script for enterprise customers created and tested on staging
tasks: Catalog reconciliation: run crosswalk between legacy SKU table and new catalog, produce delta.csv (owner: Marco Nguyen / ENG liaison)
Entitlement mapping: produce matrix mapping SKU -> entitlement_id -> quota config (owner: Product Data team / Aisha Patel)
Metering verification: synthetic replay of representative customer traffic to validate usage meters (owner: ENG-telemetry / estimate: 2d)
Billing comms automation: implement templating pipeline to emit tailored emails and release notes from catalog diffs (owner: Ops / Claire Hsu)
Console labels: update Console UI label strings and limits copy to match catalog canonical names (owner: DES-UI / Kyra Morgan)
Sales enablement: create one-pager + slide deck and record 20m walkthrough (owner: Growth / Lina Torres)
Migration helper: build CLI script and runbook for migrating customer SKUs and quotas with dry-run option (owner: Solutions Eng / Jordan Lee)
Legal/Finance sign-off: capture billing impacts and embargoed messaging (owner: Finance / Priya Shah)
Release notes review: PM-led review session and sign-off checklist (owner: Marco Nguyen)
Post-launch monitoring: define dashboards and SLOs to detect misbilling within first 7 days (owner: Reliability / ENG-SRE)
Customer notifications list: generate target lists by entitlements affected, include account manager mapping (owner: CS Ops / Naomi Kim)
timeline: 2026-02-18: First catalog diff produced and shared with stakeholders
2026-03-03: Metering replay and smoke validation completed
stakeholders: Product Management: Aisha Patel (creator), Marco Nguyen (assignee)
comms_matrix: Customers: transactional billing email + release notes page; owner: Claire Hsu; send window: 48h before launch
Account teams: targeted brief + migration runbook; owner: Naomi Kim; send window: 72h before launch
Public docs: pricing page + Console copy updates; owner: Documentation; publish at launch
Internal: launch slack channel + daily standup for rollout week; owner: Marco Nguyen; create 1 week prior
Press/Marketing: high-level positioning only after Finance sign-off; owner: Growth
rollout_plan: 1) Merge reconciled catalog and entitlement matrix into staging. 2) Run automated metering validation and smoke tests. 3) Deploy billing comms pipeline to staging and preview generated messages for three sample customer segments. 4) Conduct dry-run migration with two shadow accounts. 5) Canary release to 5% of customers for 72 hours with monitoring. 6) Full release with scheduled mass notifications and sales enablement follow-ups.
risk_register: Mismatch between canonical SKU names and Console labels -> mitigation: UI labels frozen 48h pre-launch and hotfix path defined
Undetected metering discrepancy -> mitigation: replay against historical traffic and hold launch if >0.5% divergence in invoiced units
Large enterprise contracts with custom pricing -> mitigation: manual review list and migration helper; Finance to own exceptions
Comms confusion leading to support load -> mitigation: prepare templated support KB and dedicated triage channel
